title: Kenyan Greens and Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious dish inspired by Kenyan cuisine, featuring sautéed greens and steamed pilaf.
instructions: Heat wholesome oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and sauté until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and sauté for another minute.
Add chopped greens and sauté until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
While the greens are cooking, prepare the pilaf.
Rinse brown rice and cook according to package instructions using chicken broth.
Steam the cooked rice until tender, about 10-15 minutes.
Fluff the cooked pilaf with a fork.
Combine the cooked greens and pilaf in a large bowl.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Optional: add other spices to taste.
